summary:
Phase B (library) is done. The placeholders are replaced by the finished Biblioteca screen and the demo seeding. Everything is built from kit components, with motion from motion/react, Untitled UI icons only and no emojis.

- **seed.ts:**
  - seedDemosOnce() shares one module-level promise, so StrictMode's double effect and concurrent callers seed once. It never rejects.
  - The one-time 'pauta.demosSeeded' flag means deleted demos and 'Borrar biblioteca' are not undone on reload.
  - restoreDemos() re-adds only the missing demo ids in one rw transaction (two tabs cannot both add) and returns the count. It leaves renamed or favourite demos untouched, and rejects only if IndexedDB fails, so Ajustes can show its error toast.
  - Each demo follows the engine-score request: id DEMO_ID_PREFIX + slug, analysis = demoAnalysis(demo), params = { ...demoParams(demo, getSettings()), difficulty: 'original' } (split 60/64/62), durationSec = buildScore(...).durationSeconds, summary = summarizeScore(score).
  - Two deliberate deviations:
    - quantize is pinned to 16. Demo notes are exact sixteenths; a user's 1/8 transcription default would merge the Prelude's figures.
    - pickCoverId(slug) gives the Minuet and the Prelude the same cover, so a later demo takes the next unused cover. The covers are keys-ivory, haze-lavender and keys-touch, and are deterministic on every restore.
  - Demos are written 1 ms apart, so 'Recientes' lists them Oda, Minueto, Preludio.
- **Biblioteca** ('/library', <Page variant="tab" tabBar> + <TopBar large title="Biblioteca">):
  - Top bar: FilterLines opens the filter/sort Sheet, with an accent dot while sheet filters are active. Grid01/List toggles the view, remembered in localStorage 'pauta.library.view'.
  - SearchField matches title + composer, ignoring accents and case; every word must match.
  - Single-choice chips: Todas, Favoritas, Grabaciones (mic/tab), Archivos, Ejemplos.
  - Sheet:
    - Dificultad (Fácil/Media/Difícil) and Tonalidad (keys in the library, keyName with settings.noteNaming) are multi-choice; Compás too.
    - Ordenar por: Recientes, Abiertas recientemente, Título A-Z, Duración, Dificultad.
    - Footer: Restablecer + Listo.
  - List: 56 px rounded Cover (getCover(doc.coverId)?.src with the generated fallback), bold title, quiet 'Sol mayor · 100 ppm · 0:38', a heart toggle (accent fill, with a small pop) and DotsVertical.
  - The ActionSheet offers: Abrir, Renombrar (PromptDialog), Añadir/Quitar de favoritas, Duplicar, Exportar MusicXML / MIDI / ABC (engine exporters + shareOrDownload + safeFileName), and Eliminar (danger ConfirmDialog, then toast 'Partitura eliminada'). Long press or right click opens it too.
  - Grid: 2 columns of 4:5 cover cards with a frosted caption band (title + key, ref-3 'Popular Song' style) and a glass corner heart.
  - Tap opens '/score/' + id.
  - Motion: items rise in with a stagger; on filtering, leaving items fade and the rest close the gap (layout + AnimatePresence popLayout).
  - States:
    - Empty: heroImages.emptyLibrary, 'Aún no hay partituras', ink 'Escuchar' button to '/'.
    - No results: quiet 'Sin resultados' + 'Borrar filtros'.
    - Loading: a delayed skeleton of the real layout that does not pulse with reduced motion. The screen waits for the first-run seed, so it never flashes 'empty'.
  - Search, chips, filters and sort last for the session. Back from the viewer returns to the same scroll position; the tab bar starts at the top.
- **Visual review:** light and dark screenshots of every state, compared with docs/reference and the kit. Refinements made:
  - a full-bleed glass band with one-line titles, so bands in a row are equal;
  - sheet chips on the kit's --fill, since they were invisible in dark;
  - 'Sin resultados' moved up near the search;
  - the empty-state photo slightly dimmed in dark;
  - 48 px covers under 360 px.
- **Client feedback:** docs/CLIENT-FEEDBACK.md had no entries at the start or at the end, so there was nothing to apply.

public_api_notes:
**src/data/seed.ts**
- `seedDemosOnce(): Promise<void>`: one shared promise per page load, never rejects. App already calls it on mount.
- `restoreDemos(): Promise<number>`: count added (0 when all 3 are present). Rejects only when IndexedDB fails. It also sets the seeded flag.
- `isDemoSeedSettled(): boolean`.
- `DEMOS_SEEDED_KEY = 'pauta.demosSeeded'` (localStorage, '1').
- Pure helpers: `demoId(demo)`, `demoCoverIds()` (slug -> coverId) and `buildDemoDoc(demo, now, coverId?)` (a full ScoreDoc, no DB access).
- Without localStorage, seeding falls back to 'only seed an empty library'.

**Demo items**
- ids demo-oda-alegria, demo-minueto-sol, demo-preludio-do; source 'demo'; composer set; favorite false.
- Covers keys-ivory, haze-lavender, keys-touch.
- analysis = demoAnalysis(demo): beatOffset 0, confidences 1.
- params = { ...demoParams(demo, getSettings()), quantize: 16, difficulty: 'original' }: split 60 / 64 / 62.
- durationSec 38.4 / 25.7 / 29.1 s.
- createdAt = updatedAt, 1 ms apart (the Oda is the newest).

**src/features/library**
- `LibraryScreen` keeps the same export and path.
- `exports.ts`: `exportFile(doc, 'musicxml' | 'midi' | 'abc') -> { blob, fileName }` and `scoreOfDoc(doc)`. The viewer can reuse both.
  - scoreOfDoc = buildScore(notes, sanitizeParams(params, analysis), analysis, title).
  - MusicXML: MIME.musicxml, '.musicxml'.
  - MIDI: MIME.midi, '.mid'.
  - ABC: scoreToAbc(score, { includeTitle: true, noteNaming: 'none' }), MIME.abc, '.abc'.
  - File names come from safeFileName(title).
- `filters.ts`: pure `normalizeText`, `matchesQuery`, `applyFilters`, `sortDocs`, `presentKeys`, `presentMeters`, `keyId` ('major:1'), `QUICK_FILTERS`, `SORT_OPTIONS`.
- localStorage key 'pauta.library.view' = 'list' | 'grid' (try/catch).

**Behaviour**
- The heart calls updateScore(id, { favorite }, false): updatedAt is not bumped.
- Recientes sorts by createdAt desc, so editing or favouriting never reorders the list.
- Abiertas recientemente sorts by openedAt desc, then never-opened items, newest first.
- Duración: shortest first. Dificultad: easiest first.

**Toasts**
- 'Partitura eliminada', 'Partitura duplicada'.
- '<MusicXML|MIDI|ABC> descargado', 'Partitura compartida'.
- Errors: 'No se pudo guardar | duplicar | exportar | renombrar | eliminar'.

**Selectors for the integration e2e**
- List: `ul[aria-label="Partituras"] > li.lib-item`.
- List rows: `.lib-row` with `.lib-row__main` (opens; long press or right click opens actions), `.lib-row__title`, `.lib-fav` (aria-pressed) and `.lib-more`.
- Grid tiles: `.lib-tile`, `.lib-tile__main`, `.lib-tile__title`, `.lib-tile__fav`.
- Filter button: `.lib-filterbtn button`; active dot: `.lib-filterbtn__dot`.
- View toggle: `button[aria-label="Ver en cuadrícula"]` / `button[aria-label="Ver en lista"]`.
- Chips: `.lib-chips .ui-chip`.
- Sheet: `.lib-sheet`, with chips in `.lib-filter__chips .ui-chip` and the 'Restablecer' / 'Listo' buttons in `.ui-sheet__footer`.
- States: `.lib-empty` and `.lib-noresults`.

**Gotchas found**
1. App renders `<Routes location={location}>`. react-router then reports `useNavigationType() === 'POP'` to every screen inside it, even for PUSH navigations. The library keys its scroll memory to history.state.key, read at mount, instead.
2. motion variant propagation (listContainer / listItem) does not reach children wrapped in AnimatePresence; they stay at 'hidden'. Give each item its own initial/animate (the library uses an index-based delay).
3. Cover sizes itself inline from `size`. Pass `style` to resize it, e.g. `{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }` or a CSS variable.
4. A useEffect cleanup on a route screen runs after the next screen's DOM is in place, so window.scrollY is already wrong there. Use a useLayoutEffect cleanup.

requests.request: 'Restablecer' for demo items: the seed pins quantize: 16 and difficulty: 'original' on top of demoParams(demo, settings). Use { ...demoParams(demo, settings), quantize: 16, difficulty: 'original' } so a user's 1/8 transcription default does not merge the Prelude's sixteenths. Also, inside screens `useNavigationType()` always returns 'POP' (App passes `location` to <Routes>), so it cannot tell back from forward. exportFile / scoreOfDoc in src/features/library/exports.ts can be reused for the viewer's MusicXML/MIDI/ABC exports.

Optional kit polish (worked around in library CSS): (a) unselected Chips inside a Sheet are white-on-white with a shadow and almost invisible in dark mode. The library sets `.lib-filter__chips .ui-chip:not(.is-selected) { background: var(--fill); box-shadow: none }`; consider making this the kit default inside `.ui-sheet`, as is already done for `.ui-group__card`. (b) Document in UI-KIT.md that listContainer/listItem stagger does not propagate through AnimatePresence. (c) Cover could accept a CSS length for `size` (the library passes style overrides).

docs/CONTINUAR.md section 4: library is done (phase B). Settings' 'Restaurar ejemplos' now works: '1 ejemplo restaurado' / 'N ejemplos restaurados' / 'Los ejemplos ya están en la biblioteca'. Low priority: useAllScores() loads every doc with its full notes array; a summary-only query would keep the library light with hundreds of long transcriptions.

known_issues: Grid tiles open their actions with a long press or right click. To keep the cards calm, their DotsVertical button only appears for keyboard focus (Shift+F10 / context menu also works). The list view shows the dots on every row.
Swipe-left to delete was not added (optional in the brief); Eliminar is in the ActionSheet with a confirm.
When a filter change empties the list, 'Sin resultados' replaces it at once, so the last item's exit fade is skipped.

Grid titles are one line (ellipsis) so caption bands line up; long titles are cut in the grid but shown in full in the list, the ActionSheet and the viewer. At 320 px the list meta line ellipsizes too.
With localStorage blocked, the 'seeded once' flag cannot be stored. Seeding then only fills an empty library, so in that case 'Borrar biblioteca' is undone on the next reload.
'Recientes' sorts by creation date, not by last edit (so favouriting or viewer edits never reshuffle the list); 'Abiertas recientemente' covers recent use.
Dev only: while other agents save half-written files, Vite's overlay can briefly replace the whole app, because App imports every screen eagerly (seen once with ProcessingScreen.css).

- **Tests:** `npm test` passes all 204 tests in 17 files, 29 of them mine.

  - filters.test.ts (11) covers accent-insensitive multi-word search, the five chips, AND/OR sheet filters, stale-filter cleanup and every sort.
  - exports.test.ts (5) covers well-formed MusicXML, MIDI read back with @tonejs/midi (two hands), ABC with title, no names and zero abcjs warnings, stored transposition plus safe file names, and repair of broken params.

- **Browser checks:** a puppeteer script (C:/Users/Marcos/AppData/Local/Temp/pauta/library/verify.mjs) passed 43 of 43 on my dev server (port 5186, React StrictMode). It also passed 43 of 43 twice on `node scripts/serve.mjs start 5186 --preview` (production build, service worker).
